details: Malicious package. `@neodevxsadmd/baileys-api-neko` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `lib/Socket/dugong.js`, loaded by `lib/Socket/messages-send.js`, stamps event messages sent through the library with forwarded-newsletter context naming the hardcoded attacker-controlled WhatsApp channel 120363297591152843@newsletter ("shenvn."), so recipients see the victim's message as forwarded from that channel. `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` also contains a commented-out timer that would auto-follow a base64-encoded channel (120363303656790201@newsletter); it is not active in 2.0.3. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID. Version 2.0.3 carries this code; the `0.0.0-stage` placeholder does not.
